items.lede: Ford said it's making an "explicit commitment" to its customers that "their vehicle data is safe" with the company.
items.title: Ford launches a ‘privacy promise’ and explains how and why it uses customer data

items.lede: Ford vowed to never sell customer driving data to third-party data brokers as part of a new privacy promise aimed at setting the automaker apart from competitors that have faced legal and regulatory blowback for sharing telematics with data brokers without authorization.
